description:
List the current user's signed-in devices: every session that can still renew, idle ones included. Each shows its channel, user agent and expires_at, which is when the session stops being able to renew (not when its current access token expires). When called via API key, no session is marked is_current.

NOT AVAILABLE HERE: This tool is not available on the hosted Proof MCP server: it needs the auth:read or auth:write scope, which the hosted server never grants (an agent holding it could list and sign out the owner's devices). The account owner manages signed-in devices in the dashboard: Settings → Signed-in devices (https://proof.holdings/dev). A local (stdio) Proof MCP server run with an API key that holds the scope can call it.
name: list_auth_sessions
